problem_type: Async test predicates falsely satisfy synchronous truthiness polling
symptom: Walk/e2e waits return before persisted state is ready, allowing false green or downstream races
direct_cause: Playwright 1.60 waitForFunction checks the returned Promise for truthiness before its resolved boolean
class_root: Test-source validation lacked an async predicate invariant and excluded walk/e2e scripts
affected_population: All async waitForFunction callers in test scripts

external_sources.purpose: expect.poll awaits asynchronous callbacks and accepts an explicit timeout

invariants: Inline async predicates in test waitForFunction calls are rejected before execution
generality_proof: The shared AST gate scans test scripts, unit tests and named test files, recognizing async arrows and function expressions across whitespace/comments and parenthesized forms without matching text examples.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Reject inline async callbacks independent of page receiver and layout

same_class_entry_points.evidence: trustedHosts includes cursor before connection management; migrated to expect.poll and included by collectTestFiles
node dismissal is saved before snapshot assertion; migrated to expect.poll and included by collectTestFiles
new project is readable before locating isolated disk project; migrated to expect.poll and included by collectTestFiles
three canonical shots readable before MCP edit and restart; migrated to expect.poll and included by collectTestFiles
budget=25, kie allowed and model allowed before next edit/approval; migrated to expect.poll and included by collectTestFiles

recurrence.reason: Seven existing callbacks across five independently authored tests share this reusable failure mechanism
same_class_scan: rg -n -U waitForFunction\s*\(\s*async across the repository excluding docs: seven hits
AST gate on original sources: seven hits, exit 1; after sweep: zero hits

prevention.invariant: No inline async waitForFunction predicate in scanned test sources
prevention.failure_mode: check:test-waits exits 1 and reports file/line and expect.poll replacement
prevention.strategy: Use the existing RULES gate and extend discovery for the new rule; existing wallclock rules retain their established unit-test scope

legacy_paths.rationale: Removed all seven async waits and duplicated dismissal reader; no parallel wait implementation

dependency_lifecycle.target: Upstream release with verified awaited predicate semantics if policy is reconsidered
dependency_lifecycle.rationale: Official expect.poll already supplies correct awaited sampling; no dependency upgrade needed
exit_criteria: Only reconsider async waitForFunction after an upstream implementation awaits predicates and an always-false async regression times out

migration: No persisted data or product API changes; callers switch directly to awaited polling.
residual_risks: This syntax gate targets inline async predicates; indirect Promise-returning callbacks require semantic analysis outside this sweep.
Gate and isolated sampling checks do not prove entire existing Electron/model journeys.
